research_role: Stage 1 protocol for testing held-out class transfer before student training

phase_1_proxy.purpose: low-cost no-training held-out text matching diagnostic
phase_1_proxy.candidate_sampling: image-ID-based or all candidates; never select by VLM score, margin, prediction, pixel GT, or held-out correctness
phase_1_proxy.prototype_rule: visual prototypes, if used, are constructed from seen classes only
phase_1_proxy.unseen_rule: held-out class has no visual prototype, calibration samples, threshold tuning, or prompt selection
phase_1_proxy.prediction_vocabulary: all six class names plus the frozen Stage 0 distractors
phase_1_proxy.primary_metric: held-out text assignment rate on an independently frozen evaluation subset
phase_1_proxy.inference: image-clustered confidence interval across all six folds
phase_1_proxy.claim_limit: proxy weak-label transfer only; not true unseen accuracy or segmentation

phase_2_confirmatory.purpose: pixel-level OV-WSSS evaluation after the method is frozen
phase_2_confirmatory.pixel_gt_policy: Val pixel GT may be opened once for final frozen evaluation only
selection_forbidden: checkpoint selection on unseen-class Val performance
required_reporting: harmonic mean of seen and unseen mIoU
RemoteCLIP versus frozen OpenAI CLIP baseline

leakage_controls.reason: the pack was balanced by SAM3 source weak class and is therefore selection-conditioned
leakage_controls.train_image_tags_origin: LoveDA Train pixel-mask presence simulation with minimum 16 pixels; inherited disclosure required

required_before_phase_1: an immutable all-candidate or image-ID-selected pixel package not balanced by held-out labels
a frozen row-key manifest and source hashes
a pre-result analysis commit and protocol SHA-256
required_before_phase_2: a frozen trainable method and model-selection split that is disjoint from final Val evaluation
a final-evaluation manifest describing exact LoveDA Val files and label mapping
explicit authorization to use Val pixel GT for the one-time final evaluation
